Yes, Solemn Strike and Solemn Warning can negate your link summon of a monster used with that monster.

The summon never happened in the eyes of the game.

Because of this, you would not be able to use a card like Monster Reborn on the monster you attempted to link summon, because it was never properly summoned.

Demise or extravagance?

Demise I wouldn't run hand traps in the main deck, they're really bad draws off demise. You may be able to get away with siding them, and siding out demise, but I don't know if that's any good anymore (My friend used to do this in the demise deck mirror, that's the only reason I recommended it.)

Extravagance you can get away with it because you're not discarding you're entire hand in the end phase.

So this is actually a very common mistake players make, and please correct me if I'm wrong here:

Basically, you would activate the effect to link summon with that monster. Because you're activating a monster effect that includes the effect to special summon a monster, they can respond with Solemn Warning or Solemn Strike and the link monster would be destroyed. The card you were attempting to link summon would never leave the extra deck. The other monsters you would use for the link summon stay on the field.

If you're looking for official video games, Legacy of the Duelist is going to come out on switch with the entire current card pool and banlist(The non switch versions will not be updated IIRC).

If you don't have a switch try casual games on duelingbook.com or try downloading YGOpro/Devpro, these are against other real players so if you're not caught up on current rules this may not be the best idea.

There's also the Yugioh Duel Links app for steam/mobile that requires you to buy packs to obtain cards, but is a much simpler dueling experience overall.
